meta.description: Experimental instruction parse/lower/plan behavior over host-neutral fixtures.

title: SANSA Instruction Parse, Lower, Plan, And Target Coverage

tests.description: Direct replace instruction parses to canonical instruction source.
Claimed provenance clauses parse and canonicalize before mutation intent.
Query-shaped instruction lowers candidate-relative targets into exact mutation requests.
Candidate-relative create lowers to one create operation per selected candidate.
Instruction planning preserves source provenance and exact planned target metadata.
Because and by clauses are inert instruction provenance and are preserved on source provenance.
Claimed provenance clauses must preserve grammar order: because, then by.
Candidate-relative target misses remain lowering failures.
Lowered requests keep downstream Mutate planning failures distinct from lowering failures.
Instruction target checks run after successful planning and can accept AEON-compatible intent.
Instruction can lower to valid SANSA.Mutate intent that a JSON target surface cannot represent.
JSON target validation accepts plain JSON-compatible object intent.
JSON target validation accepts unparameterized JSON-compatible list intent.
JSON target validation rejects parameterized list datatype intent even when the payload is array-shaped.
AEON target validation can accept parameterized list datatype intent that JSON rejects.
AEON target validation can accept parameterized object datatype intent while leaving schema semantics to the target profile.
AEON target validation can accept parameterized tuple datatype intent while leaving tuple member semantics to the target profile.
AEON target validation can accept parameterized node datatype intent while leaving child semantics to the target profile.
AEON target validation accepts binding-side node<T> custom profile/domain claims.
AEON target validation rejects binding-side node<T> reserved non-node value datatype claims.
One Instruction contains one mutation intent.
Repeated source-level mutation clauses are rejected even when they use the same verb.
Type-first value annotation may omit the comma in source but canonical form includes it.
The optional comma delimiter is value syntax shared by value-carrying verbs, not create-specific syntax.
Candidate-relative ordered insert lowers container and anchor addresses for each selected candidate.
Direct move instructions plan source, ordered container, and placement intent.
Append instruction syntax lowers as an insert-last operation rather than a distinct Mutate verb.
Append-in syntax is accepted as source sugar and canonicalizes to insert last.
Direct insert-after instructions lower anchor placement without using append sugar.
Direct move-last instructions plan as same-container ordered moves.
Require clauses lower into candidate-scoped Mutate preconditions rather than filtering candidates.
Instruction object literals preserve object datatype and representation intent.

input.source: create $.inventory.settings with :object, { enabled = true, status = false }

tests.description: Instruction list literals preserve generic datatype intent and list representation intent.
Instruction node literals preserve node datatype and representation intent.
Instruction tuple literals preserve tuple datatype and representation intent.
Instruction ordered insert values preserve datatype intent and representation kind like create and replace values.
Create destinations may use quoted member names when the member cannot be written as a bare identifier.
Create destinations may end in quoted member selectors, which lower to parent plus decoded member name.
Create destinations must name one member; name-pattern selectors are selectors, not member destinations.
Create destinations must name one member; wildcard selectors are expanded selectors, not member destinations.
Attribute-space create destinations lower through the .@.attribute address form.
Instruction can express datatype intent that the AEON target surface rejects after planning.
Instruction can plan an attribute-space create, but JSON target validation rejects the attribute-space role.
Instruction can plan datatype intent with a mismatched literal family, but AEON target validation rejects the reserved datatype mismatch.
Quoted date-looking text is a string literal family, so an AEON date datatype target rejects it.
AEON target validation rejects reserved radix datatype metadata that AEON Core cannot represent.
SANSA address literals may carry selector expressions as address data on an AEON target.
AEON references use exact target paths; selector expansion is not part of reference target representability.
AEON target validation rejects radixN aliases that are not reserved Core v1 shorthands.
Quoted encoding-looking text is a string literal family, so an AEON encoding-family datatype target rejects it.
AEON target validation accepts separator payloads with quoted source segments.
AEON target validation rejects separator metadata that AEON Core cannot represent.
AEON target validation rejects separator metadata on the unparameterized kadot datatype.
JSON target validation reports value-path context when a nested payload value is not representable.
Typed scalar values preserve datatype intent separately from string representation.
Nested datatype intent is parsed but flattened out of conservative Mutate operations with a warning.
Typed explicit-null values preserve datatype intent separately from null representation.
Reference-family values preserve datatype intent separately from reference representation.
Typed replace values preserve explicit datatype intent separately from representation kind.
Date literals preserve date representation kind and explicit datatype intent.
Reduced-precision datetime literals preserve datetime representation kind and explicit datatype intent.
SANSA address literal values can carry selector syntax as data without being resolved by Instruction.
Create may name a new member but does not create positional children by address spelling.
The optional comma is only the delimiter between explicit datatype intent and the value payload.
Candidate-relative remove lowers selected targets into exact remove operations.
Candidate-relative append-in syntax lowers as insert-last against each selected container.
Candidate-relative move lowers source and container addresses for each selected candidate.
Repeated require clauses lower into multiple candidate-scoped Mutate preconditions.

input.source:
from $.inventory.items.*
where .sku == "A-100"
require .qty == 0
require .sku == "A-100"
replace .qty with :int32, 10

tests.description: Direct require clauses lower into Mutate preconditions and fail during planning when false.
JSON target validation rejects tuple value intent after successful instruction planning.
JSON target validation rejects node value intent after successful instruction planning.
JSON target validation rejects AEON reference-family payloads after successful instruction planning.
Candidate-relative remove reports missing targets as lowering failures.
Candidate-relative append can lower successfully and then fail Mutate planning when the resolved container is not ordered.
Candidate-relative insert reports missing anchors as lowering failures.
Ordered insert planning rejects anchors that are not direct children of the named container.
Candidate-relative move reports missing source bindings as lowering failures.
Candidate-relative move can lower successfully and then fail Mutate planning when the resolved container is not ordered.
Conservative move planning rejects moves into a different ordered container.
Conservative move planning rejects placements relative to the moved source binding itself.
Instruction comments are lexical trivia and do not appear in canonical source.
Instruction datatype intent accepts SANSA qualifier grammar without assigning target semantics.
Unterminated block comments are instruction parse failures.
Quoted create member names must not be empty.
Quoted create member destinations do not admit trailing tokens before with.
Unterminated object value literals are instruction value parse failures.
Instruction object value literals reject duplicate field names rather than silently taking the last value.

input.source: create $.x with :object, { enabled = true enabled = false }

tests.description: Instruction list value literals reject empty items.
Instruction tuple value literals reject empty items.
Instruction node value literals require an identifier-like tag.
Instruction datatype intent uses SANSA qualifier grammar and inherits the nested-union restriction.
Instruction value payloads remain literal-only and reject query function expressions.
Instruction value payloads remain literal-only and reject non-literal query expressions.
Instruction temporal value literals reject invalid calendar dates.
Instruction separator value literals reject raw slash characters inside payloads.
Instruction temporal value literals reject invalid clock ranges.
Instruction temporal value literals reject comment-looking markers inside contiguous ZRUT named-zone payloads.
